Historical city demo geometry, 2026-11-24

The original source was a clean checkout at
f8ddbbbba211d5cb4ec6ca0a1775303ff6fce4b4. It successfully made the 14
city/demo cases in historical-city-demo-arm64.txt, each in its own process.
The original refusal records in later-reference-arm64.txt remain unchanged;
these are separately captured successful alternatives, not rewritten history.

The original producer was the historical selected source reconstructed from
geometry_sample_selected.go: the established public
geometry sample selected by kind, seed and detail through environment
variables. Relative to the historical geometry_sample.go it adds those
selectors and the established Tube and Sphere geometry tags; its existing
mesh, group, bounds, zero-time placement and material fingerprint is
unchanged. It was built against the clean f8 checkout; no manufacture source
was modified. Its output uses zero placement, seeds 5 and 11 and detail demo.

Darwin arm64, go1.27.3, default GOEXPERIMENT, GOWORK=off, GOMAXPROCS=2,
GOFLAGS='-p=1 -parallel=1 -timeout=60m'. Game's tests lane ran the build and
each case separately. The committed Ruby driver imposed a 120-second wall
limit, 4-GiB sampled RSS limit and 30-GiB free-space floor, stopping on any
failure without creating a row. The JSONL capture log contains every case's
elapsed time and sampled peak RSS; these are samples, not guaranteed maxima.
All 14 completed, with a largest sample of 1,801,856 KiB. No threshold tripped.
